_comment: The cross-language surface: object naming and the BigQuery column names that Python
writers and Java readers must agree on. This file is the single source for both —
pipelines/common/artefacts.py reads it at runtime, apps/common Artefacts.java loads it
from the classpath (Maven copies it out of this directory at build time).
Before it existed the convention was duplicated in both languages and kept in step by
a comment, so a rename in one was invisible to the other until a run failed.
_artefacts_comment: .DAT is sequenced so a large extract can be produced in parts; the sequence is
zero-padded to `dat_sequence_width` digits by whichever side formats the name.
.FLG is written last and outside the encrypted bundle, so a consumer can detect
'the extract is complete' without holding a decryption key.
_columns_comment: The underscore prefix on the src columns marks pipeline-added metadata, keeping it
apart from the contract's own TDS fields. The target table drops the prefix because
those columns are part of the published document, not metadata about it.
recon-service reads both sets by name (ReconService.java), which is why they belong
here rather than in either language's source.
